card.name: Words leading into a patient group or drug class
card.fires_on: Modifier or linking words just before a drug class or patient group in warnings, such as 'other' before hypoglycemic agents, 'pregnant' before women, or 'cular' in neuromuscular before blocking agents.

modes.label: Before a drug class
modes.description: A linking or modifying word sits right before a class of drugs, such as 'other' or 'which' after 'drugs'.
modes.example: receiving insulin or<< other>> hypoglycemic agents, beta

modes.label: Before patient group
modes.description: 'pregnant' or 'in' comes right before a patient population such as women or heart failure patients.
modes.example: including mefenamic acid, in<< pregnant>> women at about 30 weeks gest

modes.label: Inside neuromuscular
modes.description: The 'cular' ending of neuromuscular, just before blocking agents.
modes.example: patients concomitantly receiving neuromus<<cular>> blocking agents with Tobramycin for Injection
